summary: Engage in the deadly dance of rhythm combat. Customize your own gladiator!
description:
In this epic FNF-like game, you’ll be a Rhythm Knight, born to fight and defeat the deadliest monsters with the most powerful tool of them all… the music within.

It’s time to throw aside your guitar, your DJ mixer and your dungeon master robe: this unique game will bring all your passions together in one place. Awaken your combative soul with Rhythm Realms, a new RPG full of Sandbox-like characters where you’ll become the hero that your friends will line up to fight. 

Enter a brand new world as an outsider and tap your way to victory!

🎵 FIGHT IN RHYTHM COMBATS AGAINST HUMANS AND EPIC MONSTERS
Engage in unique rhythmic combats and fight humans and monsters alike. Line up your fighting techniques to music that would put any band to shame!
Discover an epic world full of deadly creatures and implacable foes like the Gorgo, the Bone Dragon and the Necrodancers.
Win amazing weapons, pets and shields like the Mithril Waraxe, the Black Crow and the Haunted Shield. 
Dance to a game that brings an FNF-mechanic into an epic world of aesthetic and musical geometry. 
Use unique cards like the Demon Slayer or the Angel Helmet to poison, burn, paralyze and more.

💥 PLUNGE INTO AN EPIC STORY
Follow the Queen of Rhythm’s epic campaigns and bet your life in haunted valleys, merciless deserts, untrodden jungles and unfathomable caves. 
Immerse yourself in a world where extraordinary forces have inexplicably tampered with nature’s true harmony.
Start out as a one-man band and meet powerful allies on your way to the top. 
Make the Queen of Rhythm want to bet on you, but beware: she will allow no toddler playing in a sandbox. This is serious business.

🏆 CHALLENGE YOUR FRIENDS IN MULTIPLAYER ARENAS
Engage in the online multiplayer mode and play to beat the band.
Someone challenging you? Make them toe the line. Tap your way to glory and prove to your friends that no monster is as deadly as you.
Invite new players to join the arena and make them go “Fnf! You really know your rhythm, don’t you?”
Try out the competitive mode to rank up to the highest leagues and win unparalleled rewards.

✂ CUSTOMIZE YOUR CHARACTER
How can you play an RPG without being yourself? Fully customize your knight to become the Rhythm Knight you truly are. 
Show off your epic gear to friends and foes in the arenas. Try on unique magic equipment and make some jaws drop!
Earn new, legendary armours with unrivalled powers to make fashion meet your fighting passion!
